h: Actress Tosin Olaniyan gifted a two-bedroom bungalow
p: Yoruba movie actress Tosin Olaniyan has reportedly received a two-bedroom bungalow as a surprise gift from a real estate company. She said the same businessman had earlier given her a plot of land.
body: Nollywood actress Tosin Olaniyan has reportedly received a two-bedroom bungalow as a surprise gift from a real estate company.

The Yoruba movie star shared the news in a video posted online, saying she was overwhelmed by the gesture. She explained that what started as content creation had turned into reality, and described it as an act of God's grace.
Olaniyan said the businessman behind the company had earlier gifted her a plot of land before surprising her with the house. She praised his generosity and asked her followers to pray for him.
Her announcement drew congratulations from fans and colleagues online, with many celebrating her new home.
more: The gift came from a real estate firm.
The same businessman earlier gave her land.
Fans have flooded her page with congratulations.
